visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a female character standing in an upscale restaurant setting, wearing a white sweatshirt and a reindeer horn headband. She holds a silver pitcher and addresses the camera with highly expressive facial movements and hand gestures. A second woman is seated in the background near wooden wall panels. The environment features dark wood trim and large windows overlooking a nighttime city street with neon signage. (2) As she continues her monologue, she shifts her posture to focus on a glass positioned on the table. She begins pouring clear liquid from the silver pitcher, gradually raising the vessel high above the table surface. The stream of water remains steady and enters the glass precisely without splashing. Her eyes are fixed on the water glass, showing a mix of concentration and playfulness. (3) She concludes the pouring action with a quick, decisive upward flick of her wrist, bringing the pitcher back against her chest. She breaks into a wide, triumphant smile and looks directly at the camera. The glass is clearly visible on the white tablecloth, filled to approximately 80% capacity with water as she poses with the pitcher.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks with high pitch variability and an animated tone, recounting a narrative about former colleagues in Traditional Chinese. The vocal delivery is energetic and fast, with clear articulation against a background of indoor room tone and faint distant restaurant chatter. The sound of a steady stream of liquid splashing into a glass becomes dominant, characterized by a rhythmic, broadband acoustic texture. The volume of the water stream is consistent, masking the quieter room tone while the speaker remains silent. A distinct male voice from off-camera says "Perfect" in English with low pitch and calm intensity. The phase concludes with the faint sound of the pitcher being moved and light background laughter.
